correctness.rationale: Every CDS contains every cut vertex; the cactus block-cut tree makes cycle restrictions independent and forces omitted noncuts to be a single interval of length at most two, then inclusion minimality reduces to consecutive noncut pairs or isolated free singleton runs (empty only if no free cycle vertices). A single swap alters exactly one block and produces path or clique factors. Bare cycles and tiny cases checked explicitly. The direct standalone verifier exhausts all 103 unlabeled connected cacti through seven vertices and 180 generated cacti, tests the size polynomial and full component graph, and passes both contrasting examples; finite tests do not replace the infinite proof.
